final_prompts.label: 01 — MARK III CHEST
final_prompts.prompt: Create a polished product-concept image of an Iron Man chest-armor Christmas ornament, labeled beneath it exactly "01 — MARK III CHEST". Front view, whole ornament visible, square warm-white studio background. The ornament has a compact red chest silhouette with sloping shoulder plates, small gold side inserts, a flat recessed collar edge and a small hanging loop at the top. The central focus is a circular icy-blue arc-reactor ring surrounding an unobstructed blank black rectangular electronic display. The display is slightly taller than wide, around 29 by 32 mm; the whole ornament is around 85 by 85 mm. Keep the real display rectangular and place it fully inside the circular reactor housing. Attractive restrained satin red armor, warm gold, dark charcoal and ice blue, shallow sculpted surfaces and clean bevels. Minimal panel lines. This is a chest plate only with no helmet or neck stalk. Soft product photography lighting with a little visible depth. No other objects, no extra lettering or logos. New visual concept only.

final_prompts.label: 02 — TRAPEZOID ARMOR
final_prompts.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup.
Create ONE premium industrial-design concept illustration of an Iron Man themed Christmas ornament enclosure with an integrated small electronic display. This is a new visual exploration, NOT a rendering of existing CAD.
Square composition on a warm off-white studio background. One object only, centered with generous margins, almost straight-on front view, very slightly elevated to reveal a modest 20–25 mm edge thickness. Entire hanging loop and bottom visible. Crisp, polished but restrained product design, attractive shallow faceted armor surfaces, clean broad color areas suitable for later multicolor 3D printing. Satin dark crimson red, warm gold, dark charcoal and luminous-looking icy cyan as the FOUR surface colors. Soft studio light. Restrained details, neither a toy face nor excessive sci-fi greebles.
MANDATORY: one clearly visible, fully unobstructed black rectangular display window, approximately 28.6 mm wide by 31.6 mm tall, slightly taller than wide with small corner radii. Keep it realistically proportioned relative to an approximately 75–100 mm ornament. No screen graphics, lettering or second black screen. Screen location must be deliberate and physically plausible for a single common electronics core behind it. Small sturdy centered suspension eyelet integrated into the top. No head with a huge rectangular mouth, no exposed human face, no raised hollow neck, no neck-shaped opening, no cables, no Christmas decorations or tree scene, no hand holding it, no manufacturing diagrams or dimensions. Render a plausible designed object, not a flat generic icon. Do not add extra objects.
Add only the exact short concept label specified below in small neat dark typography beneath the object.
Design direction: an angular Iron Man upper torso with a broad-top, narrow-bottom TRAPEZOID arc-reactor bezel around the central black rectangular display. The frame is physically generous enough to enclose the entire rectangle. Crisp layered crimson pectoral armor, chamfered straight shoulder caps, small warm-gold bicep panels flanking the display, red forearm-like side panels integrated into one sturdy silhouette. Compact top edge with a shallow collar cut, NOT a raised neck. Keep the lower center below the display plain red. Thin icy-blue trapezoid border makes a luminous reactor impression without overpowering the red armor. No eyes, no helmet, no human-face suggestions. Distinct architectural geometry and controlled bevels.
Text (verbatim): "02 — TRAPEZOID ARMOR".

final_prompts.label: 03 — STARK CORE
final_prompts.prompt:
Create a premium industrial-design concept illustration of an Iron Man-inspired electronic Christmas ornament. Label beneath it exactly "03 — STARK CORE". One object, front view, full silhouette and top hanging loop visible, square warm-white studio background and soft lighting.
This is the MINIMAL option: a slim chamfered rectangular crimson-red pendant, about 60 mm wide and 95 mm tall, with subtle warm-gold rails inset into its two side edges. A small COMPLETE circular arc-reactor emblem in icy blue and charcoal sits in the upper quarter, entirely above the electronic display. Below that emblem, fit one plain black rectangular display, roughly 29 mm wide and 32 mm tall, with small rounded corners. The screen has no graphics. The reactor emblem is physically separate from the screen and stays fully visible. Shallow satin armor surfaces, broad red panels, three or four purposeful seams maximum, tasteful gold accents. Four color areas only: crimson red, warm gold, charcoal and icy blue. A tiny integrated red suspension loop. Flat, compact, sophisticated collectible ornament, unmistakably reactor-inspired, visually quieter than elaborate armored costumes. No head, no helmet, no arms, no hollow neck. Modest 20 mm depth barely visible at the edges. No other objects or lettering.
